manual_complete_film.title: Che
manual_complete_film.overview: Steven Soderbergh follows Ernesto Che Guevara through two revolutionary campaigns. The first part traces his involvement in overthrowing the Batista regime in Cuba; the second follows his attempt to build a guerrilla movement in Bolivia. Benicio Del Toro portrays Guevara across the complete two-part film.
manual_complete_film.note: Complete two-part Cannes competition feature, premiered21May2008. Cannes lists268minutes(PartOne137+PartTwo131); Criterion director-approved later release lists271minutes. The complete work has no verified combined TMDB/IMDb identity; neither PartOne nor PartTwo provider ID is assigned. Cover is Criterion complete-film artwork; Cannes retrospective image was inspected and rejected because its small print explicitly says CHE PART ONE.

https://www.festival-cannes.com/en/f/che.note: Reviewed providerless complete-film identity; preserves Cannes whole-work selection and Benicio Del Toro BestActor prize without falsely reusing individual-part provider identities.
